dataset_name: FloodNet: A High-Resolution Aerial Imagery Dataset for Post-Flood Scene Understanding
spatial_resolution: Centimeter-level UAV aerial RGB imagery (~1.5 cm/px - 2 cm/px)
geographic_coverage: Fort Bend County and Houston metropolitan area, Texas, USA (DOES NOT REPRESENT BIHAR)
known_limitations: Collected from low-altitude small quadcopter UAVs over suburban Texas; sensor geometry, altitude, and resolution differ by orders of magnitude from Sentinel-1/2 satellites.
Does NOT represent Bihar geography, rural settlement morphology, or monsoonal river flood dynamics.
Serves strictly as a supplementary structural and exposure benchmark, not operational Bihar ground truth.
